review_improvement: Prevents two distinct CRC stimuli and persistent EEPROM effects from being collapsed into one generic injection result, while retaining every source command and evidence field.
independent_technical_reasoning: CRC read and mode5 CRC write are different stimuli even though they share block, subtype, type and address. Running both before evidence collection destroys causal attribution; choosing one without a decision may lose required coverage. The sample includes correctable plus deferred records and an EEPROM write, so PASS must be variant-specific and must account for persistent state. Because `-d` is omitted, target mapping is also mandatory. A stable counter/EEPROM post-state and approved cleanup are required before any later RAS case.
